decisions.reason: As a supporting burner component for the firm’s established radiant-heating base, it is still more economical to retain than to withdraw while the core installed business remains important.
The electric infrared panel heater line remains a strategic flagship with multiple models and fits the firm’s push toward broader lower-carbon building-climate solutions.

Compared with the flagship electric and hydrogen-focused lines, the electric halogen infrared heater appears more peripheral and more exposed to portfolio simplification after the earlier withdrawal of a related electric hall-heating line.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater stays closely aligned with the firm’s innovation direction and reference-led low-carbon positioning, so it is likely to be continued despite still-developing market demand.
